input_eligibility.gse281364: Sequence-only retrospective MPRA direction and rank diagnostic. Locus, profile, and sequence-class selection must be cross-fitted without MPRA outcomes.
input_eligibility.gse289173: Eligible for one-time sequence inference after archive, runtime, and selection locks. Sei has no donor or expression input. ALT-minus-REF regulatory probabilities or class projections are not signed eQTL or ieQTL effects without a separately frozen development-only gene-link and direction model.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Eligible for development-only center-bin accessibility classification and fitted feature heads. It cannot consume same-nucleus RNA context and does not emit an ATAC profile or count.
input_eligibility.observed_context_requirement: none_supported; fixed liver-related target profiles or sequence classes are not observed donor context

interpretation: Read-only chronology changes the registry's conservative unknown state to target_label_unexposed for GSE281364, GSE289173, and GSE296875. Sei remains broadly exposed to hg38 reference sequence and generic liver-related regulatory profiles. Its native output is a center-position probability vector, not a spatial ATAC profile or a signed gene effect.
remaining_blockers: The archive, allowlisted members, safe weights-only conversion, 21907-target order, 40 named classes, 61-row projection matrix, histone indices, strict restore, reverse-complement mean, ALT-minus-REF sign, deterministic L40S inference, and finite input-gradient backward are frozen and passed.

The released hg38 reference archive remains unacquired. Development inference instead uses the project GRCh38.p14 reference only after exact REF, center-anchor, channel-order, boundary, and primary-contig checks.
Any full fine-tuning requires a separate optimizer, resume, and cross-device numeric-tolerance contract; the current admitted path is frozen inference and input-gradient probing only.
Cross any fitted profile combiner, calibration, enhancer-gene link, or direction head over held donors and merged chromosome or LD blocks.
Keep Sei out of the RNA-conditioned ATAC profile champion comparison except as a static sequence center-bin comparator.
